JSDoc: provenance for adapted Word-binary parsing code

Upstream project: https://github.com/Alpaq92/JSDoc
Reviewed revision: 821695a884e0c0bb8592a635d9524bb3e116cd67
Original source:

Original license:
https://github.com/Alpaq92/JSDoc/blob/821695a884e0c0bb8592a635d9524bb3e116cd67/LICENSE
License Git blob: e795d52a6aecd2bd05383c808ba4fc87f5872423

Package adaptations, extracted from CrispCloud at its owner's direction:
  lib/src/legacy_word_format_tables.dart
    Formatting-page, font-table, style-table and section-property traversal.
  lib/src/legacy_word_sprms.dart
    SPRM operand and property decoding.

The Dart adaptations add strict stream extents and resource budgets, and
implement property precedence, piece PRMs, style-relative toggles, revision
retention and cell-merge interpretation against the MS-DOC specification.
The original pinned source evaluation is retained in CrispCloud:
https://github.com/CrispStrobe/CrispCloud/blob/aba2df3248ccaf77460c74219903580223694713/docs/legacy-word-parser-research-2026-11-12.md
Current package boundaries are in doc/stories-fields-lists.md,
doc/html-preview.md, doc/media-preservation.md and doc/conversion.md.
JSDoc is not a runtime dependency. The new story, field, numbering, decoration,
referenced-media and package-writing modules follow the primary specifications;
they do not import JSDoc's raw image carving or recovery heuristics.
